cockpit.title: Run and configure 1C integrations from one work center.
cockpit.description: 1C endpoints, OData enrichment, XML routes, generated 1C HTTP examples and Timeline diagnostics in one place.
cockpit.commonRoutesDesc: Start from a business scenario, then refine matchers, OData lookups and target payloads in the wizard.
cockpit.academyDesc: Guided path for inbound token, named OData connection, lookup, JSON payload and final endpoint response.
cockpit.startLearningDesc: Concepts, endpoint contract, OData profiles and visual flow steps in order.
cockpit.createODataProfilesDesc: OData ERP, OData USP or WMS with URL, user, password/secret and metadata test.
cockpit.useRecipeDesc: Copy the full business recipe with request examples, Timeline checks and common mistakes.
cockpit.noConnectorsDetail: Create a 1C, REST or printer connector to see channel health.
cockpit.integrationsDesc: Only 1C-related routes are shown: sourced from 1C, targeting 1C, or created from 1C presets.
cockpit.noIntegrationsDetail: Create the first route from 1C to API, OData enrichment, XML bridge or printer flow.
cockpit.noEventsDetail: New XML/OData/print events will appear here with a Timeline link.

odataConnections.title: OData connection catalog
odataConnections.description: Create named profiles such as OData ERP, OData USP and OData WMS. Pipeline steps then select a business connection instead of generic connector JSON.
odataConnections.newConnectionHint: Choose the 1C base where OMH will search data.
odataConnections.name: Name
odataConnections.emptyDetail: Create OData ERP or OData USP first, then use it in OData Explorer and Visual Flow Builder.

odataExplorer.title: Query 1C OData safely
odataExplorer.description: Choose the 1C base, build resource and filter, run the query, inspect JSON and save a lookup template for a pipeline.
odataExplorer.trainingDesc: Use mock ERP/WMS to learn filters, `$select` and JSON extraction before connecting real 1C.
odataExplorer.connectionHint: Choose the 1C base where OMH will search data.
odataExplorer.createProfileFirstDetail: Open OData Connections, add OData ERP/USP/WMS, then return here.
odataExplorer.safeWorkflowDesc: Build `$filter` here first, run it, inspect JSON, then copy the same resource/filter/select into Flow Builder. `$select` should contain only fields you need later.
odataExplorer.fieldHint: Exact OData field name from 1C metadata.
odataExplorer.valueHint: Use a real value here. In Flow Builder this becomes {{request.body.inn}} or another placeholder.
odataExplorer.filterTitle: Raw OData filter. You can edit it manually after using Filter builder.
odataExplorer.selectTitle: Comma-separated fields returned by OData. Use this to pick only what pipeline needs.
odataExplorer.filterTemplateHint: Template version of the filter. Example: ИНН eq '{inn}'.
odataExplorer.extractJsonHint: Map output names to OData fields. Example: {"contractor_uuid":"Ref_Key"}.
odataExplorer.extractInvalid: Extract JSON is invalid. Use an object like {"field":"ODataField"}.
odataExplorer.queryResultHint: Run an OData query to inspect request and response.

flowBuilder.title: 1C Integration Flow Builder
flowBuilder.description: Configure inbound endpoints, matchers and target actions without writing Python or editing workflow JSON by hand.
flowBuilder.noFlowsDetail: Create a no-code flow or install the marking pool preset.

training.title: Executable sandbox for 1C, OData, DNP and printing
training.subtitle: Install mock ERP/WMS, DNP API, printer, demo flows and test cases. Lessons run like real integrations and produce timelines.
training.examplesHint: Open each example in Test Console or run it directly. Error examples fail by design to teach diagnostics.
training.runHint: Run an example to see the result and Timeline link.
